images.filename: Sanggan River confluence in Yanghe River IMG 4147 Huailai and Zhuolu counties, Zhangjiakou, Hebei.jpg
images.caption: Aerial view from the east towards west, of the lower plain of the Sanggan River, by its immediate confluence into the Yanghe River.  The area in the right front belongs to Huailai county, while the main area of the image belongs to southeastern Zhuolu county. Zhangjiakou prefecture, Hebei province (China). The main village in the center is Jiahecun.
